mechanism: Diphenhydramine's anticholinergic effects may reduce timolol ophthalmic efficacy and increase risk of mydriasis/elevated intraocular pressure; systemic absorption of timolol may potentiate CNS depression from diphenhydramine.
action: Monitor for reduced antiglaucoma efficacy and increased intraocular pressure; counsel patient on additive CNS depression risk and advise caution with activities requiring alertness.
